newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-O'BRIEN COMPLETES GREAT WEEKEND DOUBLE.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-O'BRIEN COMPLETES GREAT WEEKEND DOUBLE.

text.p: Trainer Aidan O'Brien completed a great weekend double when Desert King romped to a three lengths win in the Irish 2000 Guineas at the Curragh on Sunday.
Only 24 hours earlier O'Brien had registered his first classic win when 20-1 chance Classic Park won the Irish 1,000 Guineas.
Jockey Christy Roche moved Desert King, who started at 3-1, into the lead about a furlong out and he strode away from the field.
The 33-1 chance Verglas was second with Romanov, at 11-1, third. The 11-10 favourite Revoque faded towards the end and finished down the field.
